name: First Aid
note: basic emergency care; root of the medical tree

name: Nursing
note: sustained patient care

name: Medicine
note: diagnosis & treatment; surgery is Repair + a medical field

name: Surgery
note: operative intervention

name: Emergency Medicine
note: trauma & critical care

name: Science
note: general scientific grounding; root of the science tree

name: Physics
note: mechanics, energy, materials

name: Chemistry
note: reactions, materials, explosives, pharmacology

name: Biology
note: life sciences, genetics, ecology

name: Geology
note: earth, minerals, terrain

name: Electronics
note: circuits, sensors, comms; pairs with Repair

name: Engineering
note: design & construction; pairs with Repair to build

name: Mathematics
note: calculation, statistics, proof; root of the formal tree

name: Computers
note: programming, networks, hacking

name: Lore
note: general humanistic grounding; root of the humanities tree

name: History
note: the past, precedent, context

name: Politics
note: power, factions, governance

name: Law
note: statute, procedure, rights

name: Economics
note: markets, finance, trade

name: Accounting
note: books, audits, following the money

name: Business
note: organisations, management, deals

name: Psychology
note: behaviour & the mind; aids social skills & interrogation

name: Theology
note: doctrine & the divine; relevant to Religion

name: Etiquette
note: manners & protocol; aids social skills in formal settings

name: Survival
note: living off the land; foraging, shelter, wilderness navigation

name: Tactics
note: small-unit & battlefield decision-making

name: Trades
note: the shared grounding of the building trades — materials, tools, reading a plan; root of the trades tree

name: Carpentry
note: timber, joinery, framing, formwork

name: Plumbing
note: water, drainage, gas fitting

name: Electrical
note: wiring, supply and fixed installations — the trade. For circuits and sensors see Electronics

name: Unarmed Combat
note: the grounding of any unarmed school — stance, distance, falling. Root of the unarmed tree; the specialisms below each buy one option in a fight

name: Lethal
note: strikes meant to end it: **+2 DC at −1 EF**

name: Defense
note: lets you **parry unarmed** — without it, bare hands do not control the line

name: Throws
note: lets you **throw** an opponent rather than merely strike them

name: Wrestling
note: grappling and pinning — markedly better at both than an untrained clinch

name: Exotic
note: a school your opponent has never met: they take an **unfamiliarity penalty** against you. There are arbitrarily many exotic schools, so this field may be taken more than once, each for a different one

name: Martial Science
note: the systematised study of fighting as a discipline, body and mind together

name: Natural Philosophy
note: the pre-modern grounding in how the world works — the ancestor of Science, and its counterpart in a setting that never got one

name: Alchemy
note: transformation of substances; the fantasy counterpart of Chemistry

name: Herbalism
note: plants and their properties — remedies, poisons, preparations

name: Healing
note: the practice of a world without Medicine: setting bones, drawing fevers, what works and what is merely done

name: Beast Lore
note: the habits, tracks, weaknesses and worth of animals — and of things that are not quite animals

name: Anthropology
note: peoples, kinship, custom and material culture — how a society actually works from the inside
